run_habitat_baselines_training: run a habitat baselines training experiment using hydra config and the ppo pointnav trainer
run_habitat_baselines_evaluation: run evaluation of a trained habitat baselines model by setting habitat_baselines.evaluate to True
execute_exp_train_or_eval: execute a habitat baselines experiment by seeding random state and calling train or eval on the registered trainer
main_hydra_entry_point: run the hydra decorated main entry point that patches config and dispatches to execute_exp
register_hydra_plugin: register the HabitatBaselinesConfigPlugin with hydra before calling main to enable structured config support
